mn56:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Nāḷandāyaṃ viharati Pāvārikambavane.
mn56:2.1: Tena kho pana samayena Nigaṇṭho Nātaputto Nāḷandāyaṃ paṭivasati mahatiyā nigaṇṭhaparisāya saddhiṃ.
mn56:2.2: Atha kho Dīghatapassī nigaṇṭho Nāḷandāyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkanto yena Pāvārikambavanaṃ yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi, \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \
mn56:2.3: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṃ ṭhitaṃ kho Dīghatapassiṃ nigaṇṭhaṃ Bhagavā etad-avoca:
mn56:2.4: Saṃvijjante kho Tapassi āsanāni, sace ākaṅkhasi nisīdāti.
mn56:3.1: Evaṃ vutte Dīghatapassī nigaṇṭho aññataraṃ nīcaṃ āsanaṃ gahetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
mn56:3.2: Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Dīghatapassiṃ nigaṇṭhaṃ Bhagavā etad-avoca:
mn56:3.3: Kati pana Tapassi Nigaṇṭho Nātaputto kammāni paññāpeti pāpassa kammassa kiriyāya pāpassa kammassa pavattiyā ti. --
mn56:3.4: Na kho āvuso Gotama āciṇṇaṃ Nigaṇṭhassa Nātaputtassa kammaṃ kamman-ti paññāpetuṃ,
mn56:3.5: daṇḍaṃ daṇḍanti kho āvuso Gotama āciṇṇaṃ Nigaṇṭhassa Nātaputtassa paññāpetun-ti --
mn56:3.6: Kati pana Tapassi Nigaṇṭho Nātaputto daṇḍāni paññāpeti pāpassa kammassa kiriyāya pāpassa kammassa pavattiyā ti. --
mn56:3.7: Tīṇi kho āvuso Gotama Nigaṇṭho Nātaputto daṇḍāni paññāpeti pāpassa kammassa kiriyāya pāpassa kammassa pavattiyā, seyyathīdaṃ
mn56:3.9: Kiṃ pana Tapassi aññad-eva kāyadaṇḍaṃ aññaṃ vacīdaṇḍaṃ aññaṃ manodaṇḍan-ti.
mn56:3.10: -Aññad-eva āvuso Gotama kāyadaṇḍaṃ aññaṃ vacīdaṇḍaṃ aññaṃ manodaṇḍan-ti. --
mn56:3.11: Imesaṃ pana Tapassi tiṇṇaṃ daṇḍānaṃ evaṃ paṭivibhattānaṃ evaṃ paṭivisiṭṭhānaṃ katamaṃ daṇḍaṃ Nigaṇṭho Nātaputto mahāsāvajjataraṃ paññāpeti pāpassa kammassa kiriyāya pāpassa kammassa pavattiyā, yadi vā kāyadaṇḍaṃ yadi vā vacīdaṇḍaṃ yadi vā manodaṇḍan-ti. --
mn56:3.12: Imesaṃ kho āvuso Gotama tiṇṇaṃ daṇḍānaṃ evaṃ paṭivibhattānaṃ evaṃ paṭivisiṭṭhānaṃ kāyadaṇḍaṃ Nigaṇṭho Nātaputto mahāsāvajjataraṃ paññāpeti pāpassa kammassa kiriyāya pāpassa kammassa pavattiyā, no tathā vacīdaṇḍaṃ no tathā manodaṇḍan-ti. --
mn56:3.19: Itiha Bhagavā Dīghatapassiṃ nigaṇṭhaṃ imasmiṃ kathāvatthusmiṃ yāvatatiyakaṃ patiṭṭhāpesi.
mn56:4.1: Evaṃ vutte Dīghatapassī nigaṇṭho Bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn56:4.2: Tvaṃ pan' āvuso Gotama kati daṇḍāni paññāpesi pāpassa kammassa kiriyāya pāpassa kammassa pavattiyā ti. --
mn56:4.3: Na kho Tapassi āciṇṇaṃ Tathāgatassa daṇḍaṃ daṇḍan-ti paññāpetuṃ,
mn56:4.4: kammaṃ kamman-ti kho Tapassi āciṇṇaṃ Tathāgatassa paññāpetun-ti. --
mn56:4.5: Tvaṃ pan' āvuso Gotama kati kammāni paññāpesi pāpassa kammassa kiriyāya pāpassa kammassa pavattiyā ti. --
mn56:4.6: Tīṇi kho ahaṃ Tapassi kammāni paññāpemi pāpassa kammassa kiriyāya pāpassa kammassa pavattiyā, seyyathīdaṃ
mn56:4.8: Kiṃ pan' āvuso Gotama aññad-eva kāyakammaṃ aññaṃ vacīkammaṃ aññaṃ manokamman-ti.
mn56:4.9: -Aññad-eva Tapassi kāyakammaṃ aññaṃ vacīkammaṃ aññaṃ manokamman-ti. --
mn56:4.10: Imesaṃ pan' āvuso Gotama tiṇṇaṃ kammānaṃ evaṃ paṭivibhattānaṃ evaṃ paṭivisiṭṭhānaṃ katamaṃ kammaṃ mahāsāvajjataraṃ paññāpesi pāpassa kammassa kiriyāya pāpassa kammassa pavattiyā, yadi vā kāyakammaṃ yadi vā vacīkammaṃ yadi vā manokamman-ti.
mn56:4.11: -Imesaṃ kho ahaṃ Tapassi tiṇṇaṃ kammānaṃ evaṃ paṭivibhattānaṃ evaṃ paṭivisiṭṭhānaṃ manokammaṃ mahāsāvajjataraṃ paññāpemi pāpassa kammassa kiriyāya pāpassa kammassa pavattiyā, no tathā kāyakammaṃ no tathā vacīkamman-ti. --
mn56:4.18: Itiha Dīghatapassī nigaṇṭho Bhagavantaṃ imasmiṃ kathāvatthusmiṃ yāvatatiyakaṃ patiṭṭhāpetvā uṭṭhāy' āsanā yena Nigaṇṭho Nātaputto ten' upasaṅkami.
mn56:5.1: Tena kho pana samayena Nigaṇṭho Nātaputto mahatiyā mahatiyā gihiparisāya saddhiṃ nisinno hoti bālakiniyā Upālipamukhāya.
mn56:5.2: Addasā kho Nigaṇṭho Nātaputto Dīghatapassiṃ nigaṇṭhaṃ dūrato va āgacchantaṃ,
mn56:5.4: Handa kuto nu tvaṃ Tapassi āgacchasi divā divassāti. --
mn56:5.5: Ito hi kho ahaṃ bhante āgacchāmi samaṇassa Gotamassa santikā ti. --
mn56:5.6: Ahu pana te Tapassi samaṇena Gotamena saddhiṃ kocid-eva kathāsallāpo ti. --
mn56:5.7: Ahu kho me bhante samaṇena Gotamena saddhiṃ kocid-eva kathāsallāpo ti. --
mn56:5.8: Yathākathaṃ pana te Tapassi ahu samaṇena Gotamena saddhiṃ kocid-eva kathāsallāpo ti.
mn56:5.9: Atha kho Dīghatapassī nigaṇṭho yāvatako ahosi Bhagavatā saddhiṃ kathāsallāpo taṃ sabbaṃ Nigaṇṭhassa Nātaputtassa ārocesi.
mn56:6.1: Evaṃ vutte Nigaṇṭho Nātaputto Dīghatapassiṃ nigaṇṭhaṃ etad-avoca:
mn56:6.3: yathā taṃ sutavatā sāvakena samma-d-eva satthu sāsanaṃ ājānantena evam-evaṃ Dīghatapassinā nigaṇṭhena samaṇassa Gotamassa byākataṃ;
mn56:6.4: kiṃ hi sobhati chavo manodaṇḍo imassa evaṃ oḷārikassa kāyadaṇḍassa upanidhāya,
mn56:6.5: atha kho kāyadaṇḍo va mahāsāvajjataro pāpassa kammassa kiriyāya pāpassa kammassa pavattiyā, no tathā vacīdaṇḍo no tathā manodaṇḍo ti.
mn56:7.1: Evaṃ vutte Upāli gahapati Nigaṇṭhaṃ Nātaputtaṃ etad-avoca:
mn56:7.3: yathā taṃ sutavatā sāvakena samma-d-eva satthu sāsanaṃ ājānantena evam-evaṃ bhadantena Tapassinā samaṇassa Gotamassa byākataṃ;
mn56:7.4: kiṃ hi sobhati chavo manodaṇḍo imassa evaṃ oḷārikassa kāyadaṇḍassa upanidhāya,
mn56:7.5: atha kho kāyadaṇḍo va mahāsāvajjataro pāpassa kammassa kiriyāya pāpassa kammassa pavattiyā, no tathā vacīdaṇḍo no tathā manodaṇḍo.
mn56:7.6: Handa cāhaṃ bhante gacchāmi samaṇassa Gotamassa imasmiṃ kathāvatthusmiṃ vādaṃ āropessāmi.
mn56:7.7: Sace me samaṇo Gotamo tathā patiṭṭhissati yathā bhadantena Tapassinā patiṭṭhāpitaṃ, seyyathā pi nāma balavā puriso dīghalomikaṃ eḷakaṃ lomesu gahetvā ākaḍḍheyya parikaḍḍheyya samparikaḍḍheyya evam-evāhaṃ samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ vādena vādaṃ ākaḍḍhissāmi parikaḍḍhissāmi samparikaḍḍhissāmi;
mn56:7.8: seyyathā pi nāma balavā soṇḍikākammakaro mahantaṃ soṇḍikākilañjaṃ gambhīre udakarahade pakkhipitvā kaṇṇe gahetvā ākaḍḍheyya parikaḍḍheyya samparikaḍḍheyya evam-evāhaṃ samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ vādena vādaṃ ākaḍḍhissāmi parikaḍḍhissāmi samparikaḍḍhissāmi;
mn56:7.9: seyyathā pi nāma balavā soṇḍikādhutto vālaṃ kaṇṇe gahetvā odhuneyya niddhuneyya nicchādeyya evam-evāhaṃ samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ vādena vādaṃ odhunissāmi niddhunissāmi nicchādessāmi; \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \
mn56:7.10: seyyathā pi nāma kuñjaro saṭṭhihāyano gambhīraṃ pokkharaṇiṃ ogāhitvā saṇadhovikaṃ nāma kiḷitajātaṃ kiḷati evam-evāhaṃ samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ saṇadhovikaṃ maññe kīḷitajātaṃ kīḷissāmi.
mn56:7.11: Handa cāhaṃ bhante gacchāmi samaṇassa Gotamassa imasmiṃ kathāvatthusmiṃ vādaṃ āropessāmīti. --
mn56:7.12: Gaccha tvaṃ gahapati samaṇassa Gotamassa imasmiṃ kathāvathusmiṃ vādaṃ āropehi;
mn56:7.13: ahaṃ vā hi gahapati samaṇassa Gotamassa vādaṃ āropeyyaṃ Dīghatapassī vā nigaṇṭho tvaṃ vā ti.
mn56:8.1: Evaṃ vutte Dīghatapassī nigaṇṭho Nigaṇṭhaṃ Nātaputtaṃ etad-avoca:
mn56:8.2: Na kho metaṃ bhante ruccati yaṃ Upāli gahapati samaṇassa Gotamassa vādaṃ āropeyya;
mn56:8.3: samaṇo hi bhante Gotamo māyāvī, āvaṭṭaniṃ māyaṃ jānāti yāya aññatitthiyānaṃ sāvake āvaṭṭetīti. --
mn56:8.4: Aṭṭhānaṃ kho etaṃ Tapassi anavakāso yaṃ Upāli gahapati samaṇassa Gotamassa sāvakattaṃ upagaccheyya,
mn56:8.5: ṭhānañ-ca kho etaṃ vijjati yaṃ samaṇo Gotamo Upālissa gahapatissa sāvakattaṃ upagaccheyya.

mn56:14.1: Taṃ kim-maññasi gahapati: kinti te sutaṃ: kena taṃ Daṇḍakāraññaṃ Kāliṅgāraññaṃ Mejjhāraññaṃ Mātaṅgāraññaṃ araññaṃ araññabhūtan-ti. --

mn56:17.2: Iminā p' ahaṃ bhante Bhagavato bhiyyosomattāya attamano abhiraddho yaṃ maṃ Bhagavā evam-āha: Dīgharattaṃ kho te gahapati nigaṇṭhānaṃ opānabhūtaṃ kulaṃ, yena nesaṃ upagatānaṃ piṇḍakaṃ dātabbaṃ maññeyyāsīti.

mn56:19.1: Atha kho Upāli gahapati Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāy' āsanā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā yena sakaṃ nivesanaṃ ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā dovārikaṃ āmantesi:

mn56:27.1: Bhūtapubbaṃ bhante aññatarassa brāhmaṇassa jiṇṇassa vuddhassa mahallakassa daharā māṇavikā pajāpatī ahosi gabbhinī upavijaññā.

mn56:27.14: Gaccha tvaṃ brāhmaṇa imaṃ makkaṭacchāpakaṃ ādāya yena Rattapāṇi rajakaputto ten' upasaṅkama, upasaṅkamitvā Rattapāṇiṃ rajakaputtaṃ evaṃ vadehi:
mn56:27.15: Icchām' ahaṃ samma Rattapāṇi imaṃ makkaṭacchāpakaṃ pītāvalepanaṃ nāma raṅgajātaṃ rañjitaṃ ākoṭitapaccākoṭitaṃ ubhatobhāgavimaṭṭhan-ti.
mn56:27.16: Atha kho bhante so brāhmaṇo tassā māṇavikāya sāratto paṭibaddhacitto taṃ makkaṭacchāpakaṃ ādāya yena Rattapāṇi rajakaputto ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Rattapāṇiṃ rajakaputtaṃ etad-avoca:
mn56:27.17: Icchām' ahaṃ samma Rattapāṇi imaṃ makkaṭacchāpakaṃ pītāvalepanaṃ nāma raṅgajātaṃ rañjitaṃ ākoṭitapaccākoṭitaṃ ubhatobhāgavimaṭṭhan-ti.
mn56:27.18: Evaṃ vutte bhante Rattapāṇi rajakaputto taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etad-avoca:
mn56:27.19: Ayaṃ kho te bhante makkaṭacchāpako raṅgakkhamo hi kho, no ākoṭanakkhamo no vimajjanakkhamo ti.
mn56:27.20: Evam-eva kho bhante bālānaṃ nigaṇṭhānaṃ vādo raṅgakkhamo hi kho bālānaṃ no paṇḍitānaṃ, no anuyogakkhamo no vimajjanakkhamo.
mn56:27.21: Atha kho bhante so brāhmaṇo aparena samayena navaṃ dussayugaṃ ādāya yena Rattapāṇi rajakaputto ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Rattapāṇiṃ rajakaputtaṃ etad-avoca:
mn56:27.22: Icchām' ahaṃ samma Rattapāṇi imaṃ navaṃ dussayugaṃ pītāvalepanaṃ nāma raṅgajātaṃ rañjitaṃ ākoṭitapaccākoṭitaṃ ubhatobhāgavimaṭṭhan-ti.
mn56:27.23: Evaṃ vutte bhante Rattapāṇi rajakaputto taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etad-avoca:
mn56:27.24: Idaṃ kho te bhante navaṃ dussayugaṃ raṅgakkhamañ-c' eva ākoṭanakkhamañca vimajjanakkhamañ-cāti.
mn56:27.25: Evam-eva kho bhante tassa Bhagavato vādo arahato sammāsambuddhassa raṅgakkhamo c' eva paṇḍitānaṃ no bālānaṃ anuyogakkhamo ca vimajjanakkhamo cāti.
mn56:28.1: Sarājikā kho taṃ gahapati parisā evaṃ jānāti:
mn56:28.2: Upāli gahapati Nigaṇṭhassa Nātaputtassa sāvako ti;
mn56:29.1: Evaṃ vutte Upāli gahapati uṭṭhāy' āsanā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena Bhagavā ten' añjalim-paṇāmetvā Nigaṇṭhaṃ Nātaputtaṃ etad-avoca: \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \
mn56:29.2: Tena hi bhante suṇohi yassāhaṃ sāvako:
mn56:30.1: Kadā saññūḷhā pana te gahapati ime samaṇassa Gotamassa vaṇṇā ti. --
mn56:30.2: Seyyathā pi bhante nānāpupphānaṃ mahā puppharāsi, \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \ tam-enaṃ dakkho mālākāro vā mālākārantevāsī vā vicitraṃ mālaṃ gantheyya,
mn56:30.3: evam-eva kho bhante so Bhagavā anekavaṇṇo anekasatavaṇṇo.
mn56:30.4: Ko hi bhante vaṇṇārahassa vaṇṇaṃ na karissatīti.
mn56:31.1: Atha kho Nigaṇṭhassa Nātaputtassa Bhagavato sakkāraṃ asahamānassa tatth' eva uṇhaṃ lohitaṃ mukhato uggañchīti. 57.
